definitions: To understand someone's thoughts, feelings, and motives easily and clearly.
To be able to predict someone's actions or reactions because their personality or intentions are transparent.
examples: Don't try to hide anything from me; I can read you like a book.
After all these years, I can read you like a book, so I know what you're thinking.
She's very expressive; I can read her like a book.
source: I can read you like a book
